mbb_teams: Entity: college/pro basketball teams; Grain: one row per team (columns: id, market, alias, name, code_ncaa, kaggle_team_id, school_ncaa, turner_name); Notable keys/measures: id, code_ncaa, kaggle_team_id, league_id, conf_id, division_id, venue_id, venue_capacity, logo_large, logo_medium, logo_small, venue_city, venue_state, venue_country, venue_name
mbb_teams_games_sr: Entity: team-level view of a specific game for a team (team-game row); Grain: one row per team per game (columns: game_id, season, scheduled_date, gametime, home_team, team_id, name, market, alias); Notable keys/measures: game_id, team_id, home_team, neutral_site, conference_game, tournament, tournament_type, tournament_round, attendance, lead_changes, times_tied, periods, venue_id, venue_name, venue_city, venue_state, venue_capacity, logo_large
team_colors: Entity: team color values; Grain: one row per team color (columns: id, market, code_ncaa, color); Notable keys/measures: id, market, code_ncaa, color
mbb_historical_tournament_games: Entity: historical tournament game results; Grain: one row per tournament game (columns: season, round, game_date, days_from_epoch, academic_year); Notable keys/measures: win_team_id, win_market, win_name, win_pts, lose_team_id, lose_market, lose_name, lose_pts, win_seed, lose_seed, win_region, lose_region, num_ot
mbb_pbp_sr: Entity: play-by-play events metadata at game/period level; Grain: one row per game play/period snapshot (columns: game_id, load_timestamp, season, scheduled_date, period, game_clock); Notable keys/measures: game_id, load_timestamp, period, game_clock, status, venue_id, venue_name, attendance, neutral_site, conference_game, tournament, round, game_no, away_id, home_id, away_market, home_market
mascots: Entity: mascot/species taxonomy for teams; Grain: one row per mascot entry (columns: id, market, name, mascot, mascot_name, mascot_common_name); Notable keys/measures: id, market, mascot, mascot_name, non_tax_type and taxonomic columns tax_species..tax_domain
mbb_players_games_sr: Entity: player box score/appearance for a game; Grain: one row per player per game (columns: game_id, season, player_id, full_name, team_id, team_market, scheduled_date); Notable keys/measures: player_id, team_id, minutes, minutes_int64, played, starter, position, primary_position, jersey_number, points not provided but per-player stats fields available in row
mbb_historical_teams_games: Entity: historical team-game results (team-centric); Grain: one row per team per historical game (columns: season, scheduled_date, market, name, team_id, team_code); Notable keys/measures: points_game, win (boolean), attendance, opp_id, opp_market, opp_name, opp_points_game, current_division
mbb_games_sr: Entity: game-level metadata and home team details; Grain: one row per game (columns: game_id, season, scheduled_date, gametime, status); Notable keys/measures: game_id, neutral_site, conference_game, tournament, tournament_type, tournament_round, attendance, lead_changes, times_tied, periods, possession_arrow, venue_id, venue_name, venue_city, venue_state, venue_capacity, h_id, h_market, h_name, h_alias, h_league_id, h_conf_id, h_division_id, h_logo_large, h_logo_medium
mbb_historical_teams_seasons: Entity: team season-level historical records; Grain: one row per team per season (columns: season, market, name, team_id, team_code, alias); Notable keys/measures: season, team_id, wins, losses, ties, division, current_division
